result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with high-visibility continental crosswalks and overhead traffic signals. While sidewalks and street trees are present, the multi-lane roadway creates a significant crossing distance for pedestrians without a central refuge island.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars near the intersection may block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs on both sides of the street approaching the intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, marked crosswalks, and signalized control with pedestrian heads. However, the wide roadway geometry and lack of physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions increase pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Visible cracking and patching in the roadway surface within the pedestrian crossing area can create trip hazards.

hazards.name: Wide Intersection Geometry
hazards.description: The lack of curb extensions results in a wider turning radius for vehicles and longer exposure time for pedestrians crossing the street.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and reduce vehicle turning speeds.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade the standard transverse crosswalk markings to continental or ladder patterns for better visibility to approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the cracked and patched asphalt to provide a smoother, safer walking surface for pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and pedestrian signals, providing essential infrastructure for crossing. However, the roadway is exceptionally wide, creating a long unprotected crossing distance that increases pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Excessive crossing distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a long duration without a safe place to stop.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian refuge
